content: Flat-file-to-Postgres import pitfalls: using TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE silently strips tz info and shifts times by server-locale offset (one cited case: 87% of rows shifted by 1+ hour); always use TIMESTAMPTZ and pin the interpretation timezone explicitly at import; COPY loading raw JSONL as a single jsonb column is fast but defers validation; typed column import via a script gives control over validation, batch sizing and error handling; sources found no direct treatment of ordering-with-no-sequence, id collision or partial-import verification, confirming these need first-party design work rather than borrowed pattern.
